weather._note: D-155 (2026-10-23): seeded random weather per rampage, never the one just played (Weather.pick), unless the options menu fixes one; labels are what that menu shows. The sim only picks the id (Content.weather_id()); the view gives each its look (VFX).

layers._note: What each weather lays over the time of day's look (WeatherView, VFX): multipliers on the look's ambient, sun and fog, the sky and fog colours pulled toward their own grey and dimmed, how wet the streets are (0..1, the ground shader's `wet`) and whether rain falls. Clear has no layer: nothing is built and the look is untouched. 'like' copies another weather's layer. Fog, overcast and the storm's own darkness are other builders' layers.

times._note: Director 2026-10-20: all four times of day, in this order (Content.time_for_run is the fixed order captures and tests use). D-145 (2026-10-22): the game picks one at random each run, never the one just played (TimeOfDay.pick), unless the options menu fixes one; labels are what that menu shows. Each entry overrides the look's keys; dusk is the look as written.

looks._window_palette_note: Render plan item 6, lived-in windows (D-242: windows carry the night, restrained): each lit window (as the layout lights it, a bay by a floor) takes one colour, picked by these shares, and a brightness in window_lit_gain: warm tungsten rooms (2700-3000 K), some cooler offices, a rare blue TV or bare bulb (looks.md R4 start values; the director judges them). window_palette_on 0 draws every lit window in window_lit_color. Shares sum to 1 (the cell mesh suite checks).
